sheets.name: run_1

sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS AND THE GREATSWORD go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the huge dark red greatsword, as long as in image 1, held, raised, swung or slammed as the pale figure holds it. HIS WINGS as the pale figure's: as in image 1 in his normal form, SPREAD WIDE in World Ender (the ult, and every action whose name ends in _r). sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) planted straight down under his hips, its foot flat on the ground; the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up and back behind him, bent, its foot high off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
